text: Ageas completed the acquisition in 2026 of the 25% shareholding in AG Insurance previously held by BNP Paribas Fortis, becoming the sole owner of AG Insurance.
short: Ageas is the sole owner of AG Insurance.

source.name: Reinsurance News: Ageas becomes sole owner of AG Insurance, renews bancassurance partnership with BNP Paribas
source.quote: has completed the acquisition of the 25% shareholding in AG Insurance SA/NV from BNP Paribas Fortis SA/NV, becoming the sole owner of its Belgian insurance subsidiary
source.note: Ageas press release of 8 December 2025 (newsroom.ag.be) states 'With this transaction, Ageas will become 100% owner of AG, Belgium's market leading insurer'.
